scripts.ios:add: npm run build:ios && cap add ios && npm run ios:configure
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios && cap sync ios && npm run ios:configure
scripts.ios:sync:release: npm run build:ios:release && cap sync ios && npm run ios:configure
scripts.typecheck:native: tsc --noEmit --lib ES2022,DOM --moduleResolution bundler --module ESNext --target ES2022 native/native-bridge.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:native && npm run test:js && npm run test:core
